text:
sara: FYI: planned change window tonight 22:00 UTC to apply runtime flags + minor pool restart on Dedicated. Low-risk but we'll do a short canary first. Need statuspage copy + customer email and pin instructions.
deploy-bot: schedule=2026-07-05T22:00:00Z; canary=10m; rollout=60m; auto-rollback=error_rate>6%_over_5m; notify=#eng-platform.
jorge_ops: I can handle the runbook and pins. I'll compile the auto-pin list for customers with p50<100ms.
megan_support: I'll draft both a short public statusline and a slightly longer email for impacted customers. Posting drafts below.
megan_support: STATUSPAGE (short): "Were performing routine maintenance: rolling runtime updates to dedicated inference pools. You may see brief request interruptions. Window: 22:00 UTC 23:00 UTC"
megan_support: EMAIL (impacted): "Subject: Notice: runtime update tonight 22:00 UTC

Hello,

We will perform a routine runtime update and short restart of dedicated inference pools starting at 22:00 UTC. During the restart you may see brief request interruptions or retries. If you are on our critical SLA list your workloads will be pinned to the previous runtime snapshot for the duration. No action needed unless this conflicts with a planned production window. Reply to coordinate.

We will monitor metrics and automatically rollback if error signals cross safety thresholds. Updates will be posted to our status page.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops"
ryan_product: please add a sentence in the email: "If generation quality is affected we will pause the rollout and notify customers immediately."
megan_support: added.
infra_zoe: ops note: publish short statusline 30m before, broadcast email at T+5 into the canary, and enable verbose logging for canary group. Also include link to support alias in email.
jorge_ops: PIN EXAMPLE (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/v1/pins \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
 -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
 -d '{"customer":"cust-246","route":"/v1/chat","model":"rwd-7b","version":"2026-06-01"}'
```
megan_support: I'll schedule the statuspage publish at 21:30 UTC and queue the email for 22:05 UTC.
sara: thanks all. after rollout please export token-cost delta + quick quality diff for product. keep this thread for final messaging edits only. if deploy-bot updates schedule it should post here automatically.
